processed_text: A 32-year-old pregnant woman in her second trimester from a remote village reports lower back pain, frequent headaches, and feeling weak over the past month. She has attended only one antenatal check-up so far due to travel distance and cost. She is not taking iron tablets regularly because they cause nausea. Diet is mostly home-cooked rice and lentils with limited fruits. No bleeding or severe abdominal pain reported, but she feels breathless while doing routine household work.
